searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py: '1939 florin', 'florin 1939 George VI', 'florin 1939'; work/comps.py: '1939 florin' (Gowans/Armitage only). Rate: all prices already AUD, no conversion. No UNSOLD or ASKING data in the databases.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: '1939 florin' and 'Australia 1939 florin VF' (sold, last 90 days, single coins, ignore sets); 'Australia florin 1939 George VI silver' sold. Also check Noble Numismatics and Leski realised prices for single 1939 florins in VF, and dealer asking prices (Downies, Sterling & Currency, Coinworks) for 1939 florin VF for the ASKING range.
viewing_check: Check the date is 1939 and look for a mint mark (none expected for the standard 1939 florin; confirm no overdate or die oddity). Check for cleaning, hairlines, edge knocks and real wear grade (VF vs gVF, hair detail and wattle). The dealer notes 'scarce' and 'low mintage' are unverified. Ask whether it is the flip alone or has other coins.
